description: Phase 6 demo — Risk Assessment Matrix & Response Planning (12 risks across all 4 zones)

risks.name: Key Vendor Insolvency
risks.description: Primary hardware supplier may go out of business, halting procurement.
risks.response_description: Qualify two backup suppliers; maintain 4-week safety stock.
risks.trigger_conditions: Vendor misses two consecutive deliveries or credit rating drops.
risks.contingency_plan: Activate secondary supplier contract within 48 hours.

risks.name: Lead Architect Departure
risks.description: Lead architect may resign mid-project, delaying technical decisions.
risks.response_description: Cross-train two senior developers in all architecture components.
risks.trigger_conditions: Architect shows signs of job-search activity or dissatisfaction.
risks.contingency_plan: Immediate escalation to sponsor; external consultant on standby.

risks.name: Regulatory Compliance Failure
risks.description: New data-privacy regulations may require expensive rework of security modules.
risks.response_description: Embed compliance reviews in each sprint; engage legal counsel from day one.
risks.contingency_plan: Pause development on affected modules; fast-track legal review.

risks.name: Scope Creep — Uncontrolled Changes
risks.description: Stakeholders repeatedly add features after baseline, expanding scope.
risks.response_description: Strict change control board; all changes require sponsor sign-off.
risks.trigger_conditions: More than two informal change requests per sprint.
risks.contingency_plan: Re-baseline schedule and cost; renegotiate contract.

risks.name: Third-Party API Deprecation
risks.description: External payment gateway announces API v1 end-of-life.
risks.response_description: Include API migration clause in contract with integration partner.
risks.contingency_plan: Budget 3 sprint weeks for emergency migration.

risks.name: Database Performance Degradation
risks.description: Data volume may exceed design capacity, causing slow response times.
risks.response_description: Load testing at 200% projected volume before release.
risks.trigger_conditions: Response times exceed 2s in performance tests.
risks.contingency_plan: Provision read replicas; optimize top-5 slow queries.

risks.name: Testing Team Capacity Shortfall
risks.description: QA team may be under-resourced during peak testing phases.
risks.response_description: Monitor workload weekly; pre-approve contingency budget for contractors.
risks.trigger_conditions: Defect queue backlog > 50 outstanding for 2 weeks.
risks.contingency_plan: Engage two contract testers within 5 business days.

risks.name: Network Infrastructure Outage
risks.description: Shared cloud provider may experience service disruptions.
risks.response_description: SLA with 99.9% uptime guarantee; comprehensive cyber liability insurance.
risks.trigger_conditions: Provider status page shows any degraded service.
risks.contingency_plan: Failover to secondary cloud region within 30 minutes.

risks.name: Requirements Ambiguity
risks.description: Unclear user stories may cause incorrect feature implementation.
risks.response_description: Mandatory acceptance criteria for every user story before sprint start.
risks.trigger_conditions: Story clarification requests exceed 30% of backlog items.

risks.name: Minor Budget Variance
risks.description: Small cost overruns on individual work packages.
risks.response_description: Use management reserve; track with EVM monthly.
risks.trigger_conditions: CPI < 0.95 for two consecutive reporting periods.
risks.contingency_plan: Re-forecast remaining work; reduce non-critical features.

risks.name: Development Tool License Expiry
risks.description: Software licenses may lapse due to administrative oversight.
risks.response_description: Calendar reminders 60 days before expiry; budget auto-renewal.
risks.contingency_plan: Purchase emergency licences; explore open-source alternatives.

risks.name: Office Relocation Disruption
risks.description: Planned office move may cause 2–3 days of reduced productivity.
risks.response_description: Schedule move during low-activity sprint; allow remote work.
risks.contingency_plan: Use hotdesking at partner office for transition period.
